COPY_TITLE: Copy to the clipboard, to paste in another folder or share
CUT_TITLE: Cut, to move to another folder or share

COPIED.one: {{count}} item copied: open the destination folder and press "{{button}}"
COPIED.other: {{count}} items copied: open the destination folder and press "{{button}}"

CUT_DONE.one: {{count}} item cut: open the destination folder and press "{{button}}"
CUT_DONE.other: {{count}} items cut: open the destination folder and press "{{button}}"

CONFIRM_MOVE.one:
Move to {{dest}}: {{count}} file ({{size}}).

The copy is made first; the source is removed only once it has succeeded. Continue?
CONFIRM_MOVE.other:
Move to {{dest}}: {{count}} files ({{size}}).

The copy is made first; the source is removed only once it has succeeded. Continue?

MOVED_KEPT.one: Everything was copied, but {{count}} item could not be removed from the source and is still there
MOVED_KEPT.other: Everything was copied, but {{count}} items could not be removed from the source and are still there

MOVE_CANCELLED.one: Move cancelled: {{done}} of {{count}} file copied, nothing removed from the source
MOVE_CANCELLED.other: Move cancelled: {{done}} of {{count}} files copied, nothing removed from the source

MOVE_CANCELLED_REMOVING: Move cancelled while removing the source: everything is copied, but part of it is still in the source too
MOVE_FAILED: Move failed (nothing removed from the source)
MOVE_FAILED_PARTLY: Move failed (what came before it was moved)
LEAVE: A copy is running; closing the page stops it.
ERROR_INTO_ITSELF: a folder cannot be copied into itself
ERROR_SHARE_ROOT: a whole share cannot be moved
ERROR_SIZE_MISMATCH: the copied size does not match the original
ERROR_TOO_DEEP: too many folder levels (a symlink loop?)
